The '''Socorran credit''' was the [[Currency/Legends|monetary unit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. Due to the waning of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the money became essentially valueless.
